title: A box that is a name over what belongs to it
description: The same lead-and-detail every label may carry, separated by a rule instead of by weight. A blank-free newline in `text` is the author saying these are two things; `[box] lead` is the theme saying what separates them, and this theme says a line. It is what a class, a record or a component is drawn as by hand — a name, a rule, and the things under it — and it is also where who performs a step goes when that is not the kind of thing a role should carry.
